title: Patch: a card made Radiant where it stands starts the Brittle its Radiant face newly prints, and regains a Reborn that face newly prints
notes: Issue #4817 (R4817000, R4817001): Make Radiant and De-Radiant on a card where it stands refit its Brittle count to the new face (a count its printed Brittle started goes when the new face prints none; a card on the field with no count starts the one the new face prints), and a Radiant face that newly prints Reborn gives a used Reborn back, as it already did a spent Divine Shield. Engine change only, no catalog or script change; claimed with --plays as classify's stage 2 against daee3b7's build names it.

player.title: A card made Radiant where it stands follows its new face's Brittle and Reborn
fixes: A Sack made Radiant on the field now crumbles at its Radiant face's Brittle 1, as one played Radiant does.
A Ticketed made Radiant on the field no longer crumbles, since its Radiant face has no Brittle; one De-Radianted by Prestige starts its Brittle 3.
A Unit that already used a Reborn regains it when made Radiant, if only its Radiant face has Reborn (Wrong-House Attacker, 4-mana 7/7, Jilliax and others).
